name: Long Bon International Co.,Ltd
summary: Long Bon International Co., Ltd. is a Taiwanese company that, through its subsidiaries, operates across diverse sectors including financial investment, construction, and real estate development. Its construction activities span a broad range, from residential and commercial buildings to advanced technology plants, public infrastructure projects, and comprehensive turnkey solutions. The company also actively engages in the real estate market by investing in, developing, leasing, and selling properties. Founded in 1977, Long Bon International Co., Ltd. is headquartered in Taipei City, Taiwan.
